name: KENERGY
recent: Kawan Renergy 在 2026 年 9 月 25 日公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度业绩，营收同比增长 32.6%，但净利同比下滑 72.8%。此前公司在 8 月 27 日获得 2.5MW 生物质发电厂的 feed-in 批准。
notable: 获得 2.5MW 生物质发电厂的 feed-in 批准。
公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度业绩，营收同比增长 32.6%，净利同比下滑 72.8%。
risks: 电厂项目出现成本超支。
Kenanga 在业绩未达目标后下调评级。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度营收为 MYR 46.488 百万，同比增长 32.6%，环比增长 1.4%；净利为 MYR 2.038 百万，净利率 4.4%，同比下滑 72.8%，但环比增长 177.3%。

recent_en: Kawan Renergy released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026 on 25 September 2026, with revenue up 32.6% year-on-year but net profit down 72.8% year-on-year. Earlier, on 27 August, the company secured feed-in approval for a 2.5MW biomass plant.
notable_en: Secured feed-in approval for a 2.5MW biomass plant.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026, with revenue up 32.6% year-on-year and net profit down 72.8% year-on-year.
risks_en: Cost overruns at a power plant project.
Kenanga downgraded the stock after earnings missed targets.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 46.488 million, up 32.6% year-on-year and 1.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 2.038 million with a net margin of 4.4%, down 72.8% year-on-year but up 177.3% quarter-on-quarter.
